mostWorthwhile.text: Making ATP from glucose and oxygen, then using it to build proteins and power the pump, connected food and oxygen to two different cell jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Supplying glucose felt mostly like a setup step on its own; its purpose became clearer once oxygen was added.

surprise.text: The pump moved particles toward the more crowded side while using ATP; I had not expected that direction from the word transport alone.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and goals suggested the pairings, although they did not explain every detail of how respiration works.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing one ATP supply connect to protein building and a working pump made me curious about how cell parts support larger body structures.
